name: Pre-push CI checks
description: Run spell check, markdown lint, Dart format, and Dart analyse before any push to ensure CI will pass.

then.prompt:
If the command being executed is a git push, first run the following checks and only proceed with the push if they all pass:
1. cspell "**/*.md" "**/*.dart" --locale en-GB --config cspell.json
2. markdownlint "**/*.md" --config .markdownlint.json
3. dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
4. flutter analyze
5. flutter test
If any check fails, fix the issues before pushing.
